title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B via Ollama on a ThinkStation PGX (GB10)
slug_note: The zero-effort lane on GB10 silicon: Ollama's default quant does 60.2 tok/s on the 35B MoE, and 11.5 on the dense 27B — the MoE gap in one row.

caveats: The dense 27B on the same box does 11.5 tok/s with TTFT 40 s at 32K (175 s at 128K) — kept as context here because this card is the 35B MoE lane.
Ollama's default quant is a convenience choice, not a quality-optimised one; compare against the GGUF/MLX lanes before trusting it for quality work.
License is the upstream Qwen weights' Apache-2.0; Ollama's packaging adds no further restriction.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-26): `ollama run qwen3.6:35b-a3b` answered after 14.3 s from a cold start (model files read from disk); 33.4 GiB resident. Ollama 0.40.10 on the 128 GB Spark picked a 262,144-token default context by itself, so memory is weights plus that KV. Set num_ctx lower to save memory.
